notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier; maps to person_source_value to retain the original NHANES ID.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, not a clinical measurement. Stored in observation with a custom concept for survey weights.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored similarly in observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/quality of recall. Maps to observation with a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an operational identifier, not a clinical concept. Stored as string in observation.
Breast-fed infant indicator. OMOP concept 4075922 'Breastfeeding' can be used; value_as_concept_id would be 45877994 'Yes' or 45878245 'No'.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as number in observation.
Days between intake and HH interview is a continuous numeric value. Stored in observation.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Could map to custom day-of-week concepts in observation.
Language used mostly is a sociodemographic attribute. Stored in observation with language concepts (e.g., OMOP Language domain).
Main respondent indicator is operational metadata. Stored in observation with custom concepts.
Helped in responding indicator is operational metadata. Stored in observation.
Number of foods/beverages reported is a count. Stored as number in observation.
Salt used at table yesterday? OMOP concept 435314 'Salt use' with value Yes/No concepts.
Type of salt used yesterday is a detail of salt use. Can be stored as value_as_concept_id with specific salt type concepts under the same observation_concept_id.
